title: Hot Code Reloading in C
summary: A long Tsoding Daily programming stream in which he implements hot code reloading in C by loading a dynamic library at runtime without stopping the main program. It also touches on migrating struct versions across reloads.
why: HN commenters cite it as a hands-on example of hot reloading and live coding in C.

categories.name: C, C++, Rust, Go & systems languages

quote.text: he hot reloads a dynamic library without interrupting the main program, to test different functionality.
